refnamediv.refpurpose: Set the value of an SNMP object

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
hostname
The hostname of the SNMP agent (server). The hostname may be followed by a port, as in host:port; an IPv6 address must be enclosed in square brackets when used with a port ([::1]:161). Transport prefixes such as udp: or tcp: are not supported.
community
The write community.
object_id
The SNMP object id.
type
&snmp.set.type.values; &snmp.set.type.values.asn.mapping; &snmp.set.type.values.equal.note; &snmp.set.type.values.bitset.note;
value
The new value.
timeout
The number of microseconds to wait for a response on each attempt, without backoff. A call can therefore last up to timeout multiplied by (retries + 1). The default, -1, uses the library default of 1 second.
retries
The number of times to retry if timeouts occur. The default, -1, uses the library default of 5 retries.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a ValueError if:
the hostname contains null bytes, or is 128 bytes or longer.
the port in the hostname is greater than 65535 or negative.
the community is empty or contains null bytes.
timeout is lower than -1.
retries is lower than -1 or greater than INT_MAX.
object_id is an empty array.
type is not a single character.
These checks are done before any network access.
